white_lily.damage_mitigation.desc: This attribute affects the final damage you receive. For example, if the final damage received is 4 and this attribute is 3, then the final damage received will be 1. When dealing with "damage reduction", this attribute is calculated first.
white_lily.damage_reduction.desc: This attribute affects the final damage you receive. For example, if the final damage received is 10 and this attribute is 0.1, you will receive a 10% reduction in final damage. If the final damage received is 9, this attribute provides 1% of final damage reduction for every 0.01 point. The decimal part after the second digit of this attribute will not be calculated. For instance, if the attribute is 0.012, it only provides a 1% reduction in final damage. This is handled differently from "damage resistance" when calculating this attribute
white_lily.load_capacity.desc: When this attribute is lower than 100, for every decrease of 100 by an integer, the final damage received and inflicted by the player increases by 20% and 10% respectively. This ratio can only be raised to a maximum of 200% and 100%. Once it drops below 100 by ten integers, every time the player is injured, an additional special damage based on the ratio of each decrease of 10 integers (N * 100% of the player's maximum health) will be imposed. This ratio will not exceed 5000% and will not be affected by the aforementioned "damage increase +%" amplification
white_lily.all_spell_power.desc: This attribute is equivalent to all the "elemental" spell strength described in (The [ISS] Iron's Spells and Spellbooks).
white_lily.all_spell_resis.desc: This attribute is equivalent to all the "elemental" spell resistances described in (["[ISS] Iron's Spells and Spellbooks"] by Iron)
white_lily.rifle_expertise.desc: This attribute affects all "gun type damage" in "TaCZ Eternal Gun Workshop: Zero". For every 0.01 point of this attribute, the final "gun type damage" increases by 1%. And this attribute is recalculated when "Gun Synergy" is processed
white_lily.rifle_enhancement.desc: This attribute affects all "gun type damage" in "TaCZ Eternal Gun Workshop: Zero". For example, if the final "gun type damage" is 5 and this attribute is -1, the final "gun type damage" will be 4. When "Guncraft Specialization" is processed, this attribute is calculated first
white_lily.spell_enhancement.desc: This attribute affects (in "Irons Spells and Spellbooks [ISS]" and its accompanying "T.O Magic and Extras - Irons Spells Addon") the final damage of spell-type damage. If this attribute is 1, the final damage of spell-type damage will increase by 1. And when "Spell Mastery" is processed, this attribute is calculated first
white_lily.spell_critical_strike.desc: This attribute affects the final damage of spell type damage in the "([ISS] Iron's Spells and Spellbooks Irons Spells n Spellbooks)" and its accompanying "T.O Magic n Extras - Irons Spells Addon". This attribute provides 4% damage range per 1 point. The decimal part of this attribute will not be calculated. For example, if the attribute is 1.83, it will only provide a 4% damage range (damage range: The spell type damage you cause will receive a random percentage increase within this range). This attribute is calculated after the "Spell Enhancement" processing
white_lily.expert_in_archery.desc: This attribute affects the final damage of the original arrow type. If this attribute is 1, the final damage of the arrow type will increase by 1. When processing "arrow critical damage", this attribute is calculated first
white_lily.arrow_strike.desc: This value provides a 1% chance of triggering "Arrow Critical Damage" every 0.01. The decimal part after the second digit of this attribute will not be calculated. For example, if the attribute is 0.0018, it will only provide a 0.1% chance of triggering "Arrow Critical Damage"
white_lily.arrow_crit_damage.desc: When this attribute is triggered, you will deal an additional "arrow critical damage" based on the percentage of the Nightmare damage attribute when dealing the final arrow type damage. This value is converted at a rate of 1% per 0.01, and this attribute is processed after "Archery Proficiency" is handled
white_lily.recovery_interval.desc: This attribute affects the interval at which saturation is restored to replenish health points each time, but it will never reduce the recovery interval to less than 100 game ticks
white_lily.restore_health.desc: This attribute affects the amount of health restored by each saturation depletion. If it is negative, it will instead deduct health after a certain interval
white_lily.stamina.desc: This attribute affects the consumption amount of the saturation behavior as well as other aspects related to physical strength. When its value is too low, it will seriously affect mobility and saturation consumption
white_lily.building_endurance.desc: This attribute only affects the upper limit of the player's saturation level. The higher this value is, the higher the upper limit of the player's saturation level will be
death.attack.depletion: %1$s Died due to famine. His suffering will never end.
death.attack.depletion.1: %1$s died from hunger and cold. May God prevent him from dying again due to hunger.
death.attack.depletion.2: %1$s is starving to death. §cLook at our special guest. How comically he died!
death.attack.depletion.3: The stomach of %1$s has shrunk. §c Clearly, even the "improved" body cannot escape the fate of death.
death.attack.depletion.4: %1$s died of hunger, but His flesh remained incredibly beautiful.
death.attack.depletion.7: %1$s is so hungry that he's praying to God, Amitabha Buddha~
death.attack.depletion.8: %1$s was favored by the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse.
death.attack.depletion.11: %1$s The guru of the valley failed to prove the Tao
death.attack.depletion.12: %1$s fell into an eternal sleep due to hunger.
